flags.why: The use of thau for a washbasin is mainly Southern and needs a regional label.
The example defines rau câu instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Người dân thu hoạch rau câu để làm thạch. = Local people harvest the seaweed to make agar jelly.

flags.why: This muddy-place sense shares the Southern regional restriction of the mud sense.
Câm họng can be an insulting command to shut up, but colloquial does not warn learners of its offensiveness.
Sự vật belongs to abstract or formal discussion rather than ordinary casual references to things.
Learners are more likely to encounter nổi sùng in everyday Vietnamese than the bound reverence sense.
Cá trích means herring, whereas sardines are cá mòi.
The translation incorrectly identifies cá trích as sardines.
flags.fix: Mum bought herring to fry until crisp.
